column3: One rolldown codeSplitting group, vendor, takes every node_modules module tagged $initial (statically reached from the entry); startup JS drops from 264,996 to 252,233 bytes gzip -9 (main a07d81f7) and from 37 to 14 chunks; the startup set gains two @ui-sdk/core list modules (async-options, listbox-value, about 10.8 KB source) that the entry reaches through the lists barrel and main shipped only lazily
column4: Deploy blocker: the budget is 255,000 bytes. Lazy UI SDK element chunks had split the shared SDK core and other vendor modules into many small, poorly compressing startup chunks. A plain path regex hoists lazy-only modules into startup (276,035 B), so the group needs the $initial tag. A UI SDK-only group reached 254,624 B; widening it to all initial vendor code leaves more headroom and caches across deploys
column5: Sourcemap diff of startup modules against main: the same set, plus two small listbox helpers; sizes summed over the scripts and modulepreloads in dist/index.html
